code_summary: ocmsadminui utils/validation/NoticeSearch/{Valid,ValidNoticeSearchAll,ValidNoticeSearchUpload}, pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchForm,hook/useSearchParams,context/NoticeSearchUploadContext,page/upload/UploadErrorList}, components/datagrid/table/TableBody; ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{SuspensionProcessingController,helpers/SuspensionProcessingHelper} and crud/beans/SystemConstant (eligibility messages). Other repos not relevant
note: Status in stories.json: Fully paid, 1 point. A wrongly formatted notice number is rejected before the query with an error in a modal. For 'no matching notices', the normal search only shows the text 'No records to display' in the table (not an error prompt), while the upload path shows a 'Record is not found' row in a red 'Record Not Found' box. For paid or cancelled notices the search does not reject anything: All mode lists them as they are, Outstanding mode hides them so the result is simply empty without explanation; the rejection 'Unable to TS as one or more Notices has been paid' only appears when the officer chooses Apply TS (see OCMS17.5). A cancelled (PS-CAN) notice is rejected with a 'permanently suspended' message, not a 'cancelled' one. The i18n message text was not read from the language file; cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. Notice number format is fine; 'not found' and 'paid/cancelled' do not appear as an error prompt in the normal search.

steps.step: A search value with a wrongly formatted notice number is rejected with an error message
steps.detail: NoticeNo calls Format('NOTICE', value) and fails with the i18n key error.notice_no.format when the format is wrong (Valid.ts:18-31), wired into the All form (ValidNoticeSearchAll.ts:25). On Apply, validate() throws an error that is shown in a modal (NoticeSearchForm.tsx:52-69). An empty search or a single criterion is also rejected with 'Please enter at least 1 field...' / 'Please enter another field...' (useSearchParams.tsx:37-41,100-101). The i18n message text was not read; cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: No matching notices: OCMS shows an error message
steps.detail: A normal search that finds nothing only empties the table with the text 'No records to display' (TableBody.tsx:19); there is no modal or error message. The upload path is closer to the story: a row that is not found gets the error 'Record is not found' (NoticeSearchUploadContext.tsx:134-135) and is listed in a red 'Record Not Found (n)' box (UploadErrorList.tsx:50-53). Sebagian because the main search path gives no error prompt.

steps.step: A paid or cancelled notice is rejected with an error message
steps.detail: The search does not reject paid/cancelled notices: All mode lists them, Outstanding mode filters them out through defaultFilters (NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:105-125) so the result is empty without explanation. The error message only appears at the Apply TS step through /staff-check-suspension-eligibility: a notice with crsReasonOfSuspension or PRA is rejected with 'Unable to TS as one or more Notices has been paid.' (SuspensionProcessingHelper.java:299-301; SystemConstant.java:293) and a PS notice whose reason does not allow TS (including PS-CAN) with 'Unable to TS as Notice has been permanently suspended' (SuspensionProcessingHelper.java:303-310; SystemConstant.java:294). The message is shown in a modal (ApplyOperationAction.tsx:139-149). There is no dedicated 'cancelled' message. Sebagian because the error appears at Apply, not at search.
